Command: Follow My Example as I Follow Christ
Summary: Paul's imitation command: be followers of me, even as I also am of Christ — and mark those who walk after the same pattern.
Commandment: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
Application: Imitation is conditional and mediated: Paul offers himself only insofar as he follows Christ, and points to a pattern others also walk in. It authorises example-based discipleship without making any man the standard.
Purpose: TRADITIONAL reading: to make mature example a legitimate, if subordinate, guide for newer believers.
Function: Paul offers himself only insofar as he follows Christ — imitation is conditional and mediated. The apostles gave this one, not Moses — the civil, ceremonial, and moral division does not sort it. Its goal, on the TRADITIONAL reading, was to make mature example a legitimate, if subordinate, guide for newer believers. The evil it addressed was exampleless discipleship — new believers with no pattern to walk in. It restrained that evil by the pattern itself: follow me as I follow Christ, and mark those who walk after the same pattern.
